note: The people we SERVE (customer avatars / ICP) — distinct from config/character-bible.json, which is our CAST (the hosts/agents we ARE). Every offer, story, 101 list, and the intro movie ties to 1-2 of these. Story arc for each: Situation -> Pain/Fear -> Discovery of the AI sidekick -> Implementation -> Quantified ROI -> Transformation + Invitation. Absorbed from the uploaded Character Bible v1.0 (geo: LA in the source; adaptable to the user's city). ROI figures are illustrative until real client wins land.

PER-01.fate: The voice, amplified — waitlisted practice, daily content in her exact voice, signature group program, leaves at 4pm
PER-01.line: I didn't lose my voice to AI. I finally got loud enough to be heard.

PER-02.fate: The second location — waste down, ratings up, team stayed because shifts got better; second cafe opens
PER-02.line: Turns out AI wasn't for the big chains. It was for us.

PER-03.fate: The founder's chair — pipeline scored before breakfast, onboarding runs itself, strategy 3 days/week, first real vacation
PER-03.line: The business finally scaled past me — in the good way.

PER-04.fate: The craft, protected — grind automated, taste intact; fewer, bigger clients; known for work no machine dreams alone
PER-04.line: AI does my busywork so I can do my life's work.

PER-05.fate: The trusted advisor — private doc review w/ human sign-off; sells judgment, not hours
PER-05.line: My license was never at risk. My evenings were.

PER-06.fate: The one that shipped — systematized while rivals hired; seed closed on traction; the deck updated itself
PER-06.line: Speed was the moat. The sidekick was the engine.
